A '''force technical service''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[systems admiral]]. Each FTS was comprised of eight transports, usually [[Evakmar-KDY transport]]s, with each transport accompanied by two escort [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]. Each transport contained technical and mechanical specialists organized by ship. FTS personnel were called in if a system needed to be replaced, or significant modifications had to be made. FTS could not repair dead ships, but could service them and transport them to [[deepdock fleet]]s. If the vessel was beyond repair, FTS could salvage the ship's components as necessary.
